description.value: Bliss Bakery is a family-owned artisan bakehouse that has been operating on Okanagan Lake's shoreline in Peachland for over 20 years, producing slow-fermented sourdoughs, buttery croissants, and a full bistro lunch menu using only natural, preservative-free ingredients. The Peachland location sits on Beach Avenue with a lakeside patio and views of Okanagan Lake, making it a natural rest stop on any lakeshore cycling route. The sourdough starter — originally cultivated from Okanagan Valley grapes — has been in continuous use since the bakery opened in 2005.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this OSM record maps to the Peachland location of Bliss Bakery (101–4200 Beach Ave), distinguishable from the West Kelowna location by address and coordinates. The website's shop page explicitly lists a 'Vegetarian' category with 10 products, confirming vegetarian options. Bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, and most other amenities are not mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are left null per evidence-only policy.
